title: Garage
no_car_sightings: No sightings of this car yet.
max_cars: You have 3 cars in your garage, the maximum. Remove one to add another.
no_cars_description: Add your car to hear when spotters find it. Your plate is never shown to anyone unless you choose so.
pending_explanation: Pings start once your ownership is verified. During the beta the Redline team checks every owner by hand.
paused_explanation: Pings are paused: spots of your car are not sent to you.
other_model_hint: Not in the sticker book? Type the brand and model.
plate_privacy_body: Your plate becomes a secret code (a keyed hash) on the server, plus its last two characters. It only recognises your car when a spotter's Auto-fill reads it. It is never shown, unless you pick Vanity plate.
registered_toast: Car added. Pings start once your ownership is verified.
visibility_hidden_description: Spotters see nothing about you. This is the default.
visibility_badge_description: Spotters of your car see a Verified owner badge and your shout-out.
visibility_vanity_description: Spotters also see your plate as text. Their photos stay blurred.
visibility_pending_note: Spotters only see this once your car is verified.
confirm_plate_hint: To show your plate, confirm the plate you registered.
shoutout_placeholder: e.g. Thanks for the spot. Say hi at Spa.
pause_description: No new sightings while paused. You can resume at any time.
remove_message: You will no longer get pings for it, and its sightings are deleted. Spots by others stay in their albums.
not_found_description: This car is not in your garage (anymore).
